problem_statement: The paper treats portfolio optimization as the task of distributing a budget across assets to maximize expected returns while minimizing risk. It frames this as a discrete optimization problem that can be encoded for qutrit-based counterdiabatic quantum computing.

classical_baseline: The paper compares its qutrit approach against the standard qubit paradigm, and more generally against the usual digital/adiabatic quantum computing setup used for optimization. In the portfolio section it explicitly contrasts qutrits and qubits on the same problem instances.
